body:
Part of track #51 (Publish hkb to npm). Decisions are settled here — do not revisit them.

## What
- Add the missing `LICENSE` file (MIT, matching package.json).
- `package.json`: verify `files` ships everything `hkb init` needs at runtime — `skills/`, `templates/`, `hooks/`, `.claude-plugin/`, `bin/`, `src/` — and nothing else (no test/, docs/, .kanban/). Sanity-check `keywords`, `engines`, `repository`, `bin`.
- Run `npm pack --dry-run`, review the file list line by line, and paste it into your completion metadata so the next nodes can see exactly what ships.

## Done when
`npm pack --dry-run` lists precisely the runtime set; `npm run lint && npm test` green.
title: Publish-readiness audit: package metadata and tarball contents
